name: fee-dashboard
description: Fee Dashboard — run both backend and frontend with npm run dev

scripts.setup: cd backend && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && node prisma/seed.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.install: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
